gaps.sentence: The ___ (LONG) of the film is 145 minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'The length' — noun from long (spelling change: long → length).

gaps.sentence: The ___ (INTRODUCE) of the euro changed European trade.
gaps.explanation: 'The introduction of' — the noun for starting something new.

gaps.sentence: The mountain road has been ___ (WIDE) to cope with coach traffic.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'has been widened' — the verb form meaning made wider.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DIFFICULT) terrain slowed the rescue team.
gaps.explanation: 'Difficult terrain' — adjective needed; 'difficulty' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (SAFE) of passengers is our priority.
gaps.explanation: 'Safety' — the quality noun from safe (safe → safety).

gaps.sentence: The bacteria are ___ (SEE) to the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: 'Invisible' = impossible to see — the negative adjective from VISIBLE/SEE.
